subject: Zoning Recodification Cleanup
overview: The Committee of the Whole met to address follow-up items from the recently enacted zoning recodification, approving several scrivener's error corrections and requesting draft language for planned development district fees. The committee also received updates from staff on Phase Two zoning consultancy, an upcoming zoning map revision, and prospective ordinance amendments.

items.title: Planned Development District Fee Schedule and 53G Review
items.summary: The committee requested that the planning department draft language establishing a Planned Development District fee of five cents per square foot for projects over 5,000 square feet and forward peer review regulations adopted under Chapter 53G for council review.

items.title: Scrivener's Errors in Parking Regulations
items.summary: Voted to correct scrivener's errors in the use table to reinstate parking code A1 across multiple multifamily residential categories and restore the table formatting for alternative minimum parking incentives, while requesting staff review previous meeting records regarding exemptions for small non-residential uses.

items.title: Placement of Parking and Loading Tables
items.summary: Voted to insert the parking and loading requirement tables directly below Table A in the zoning appendix for clarity and ease of reference.

items.title: Textual Scrivener's Errors in Zoning Ordinance
items.summary: Approved a package of typographical, grammatical, and referencing corrections identified throughout the recodified zoning text, excluding section 6.4.7 regarding property access.

items.title: Building Commissioner Update on Zoning Map and Operations
items.summary: Building Commissioner Bill Forte presented an initiative to produce an updated, interactive GIS-compatible zoning map within three months and outlined potential future zoning adjustments concerning similar-use determinations, nuisance mitigation, mechanical penthouses, and split lots.

items.title: Scope and Procurement for Phase Two Zoning
items.summary: Director Alicia Hunt outlined procurement options to retain an on-call planning and legal consulting team for Phase Two comprehensive zoning work, and announced state technical assistance for MBTA communities compliance alongside grant funding for climate-oriented zoning.

items.title: Committee Report and Retention of Papers
items.summary: Voted to report out the questions resolved during the meeting and keep papers 22-533 and 22-581 in committee.
